quest.title: Latecoming Homecoming
quest.description: Giustino has made up his mind to return to his hometown, Petrichor...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, what are you waiting for? Get onboard, sailor!

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: #Thank you so much, {M#good sir}{F#kind ma'am}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My Waverider's a fast and steady boat. Hop onboard, and we'll be off.

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, you don't look so good. You sure you're okay?

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: I... I'm just a bit seasick. Ugh... Sorry! I—I'll just throw up over there for a bit. Be right back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Uh, sure, but don't forget to come back as soon as possible!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a good long while...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, something's not right. Why isn't Giustino back yet?

choices.text: Did he vomit till he passed out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!? That serious? But you were keeping the boat pretty steady... Or maybe it's because Paimon floats...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Either way, we've gotta find him, and fast!

choices.text: Uh oh, is he trying to wiggle his way out of paying?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Didn't he say he was a big-shot booming businessman, though? Was he fibbing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there. Have you seen a merchant from Fontaine dressed in Sumeru garb?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain the situation...

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: So this fellow you're looking for is named "Giustino," and he claims to be from Petrichor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! Have you seen him? Wait — were you two acquainted from before?

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Just acquainted? Hah!

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Still, even if I recognize him, I wonder if he still recognizes his little brother. So many years away, and not a letter sent back. Why, I've already had a tombstone erected for him behind the town!

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: And now he's back... and he hasn't paid his boat fare? Disgraceful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait, but we're... the victims here, aren't we? And if Giustino really did faint from discomfort somewhere...

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: *sigh* Fine, I'll go search together with you. I'm a local, so I know our surroundings better. Also, I have some idea as to where he'll be.

choices.text: We shouldn't comment too much as outsiders...

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. Glorious! We can go now, can we not?

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you pulling my leg? "I'm sorry, but I really don't remember"?

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Don't you know what this uniform means? Doesn't it remind you of anything?

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: O—Of course I know what you do, but I'm debt-free! Or I should be... unless a friend took a loan in my name...

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: A friend? Who cares about those excuses? I only recognize what's written here on the contract in black and white — and it's my duty to make violators pay up.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: This is my first job, you know! I wanted to be worthy of this uniform, so I showed up at the specified location three days in advance! Three days!

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: I spent them thinking about the excuses you'd make to get out of paying, and how I'd respond...

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: And then you just upped and ran! All that effort I put in, wasted! Now, I've no choice but to go by the book and...

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Teach you a lesson first, and then bring you back to report!

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: No! I don't want to leave Petrichor anymore! H—Help me!

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Stop it! Does any amount of money owed warrant such cruel treatment!?

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: #Please, {NICKNAME}! Don't let him hurt Giustino! Only you can stop him now!

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: H—Hired help!? Seriously, would you rather pay through the nose for a powerful bodyguard than just follow a contract? I'll... never understand you merchants...

choices.text: No, I just couldn't control myself after seeing your uniform...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...But y'know, if he's in this much debt, it seems unlikely that we'll get paid at all...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: No, I... still have enough for the boat fare. I counted — I should be fine on that front.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: Then what about the contract and debt he speaks of? Is that, perchance, the "souvenir" you're giving us after more than ten years?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: How could you say that, Giovanni? I really don't know a thing about the contract he's talking about! *sigh* I don't know what to say to make you believe me, though.

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: Heh. The handbook says that people will lie and do all they can to wriggle out of debt, but the contract is clearly written — don't you even try.

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: You still owe us payment for ten crates of materials to make those blasted flutes of yours...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: ...Wait, what did you say? Flutes?

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: ...Are you still sticking to the pretense even now, "Participazia"? ... Grr, you Fontainians sure have names that are annoying to pronounce...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Sorry... but who's that? My name is Giustino. Giustino Pasquale...

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: O—One moment! Let me see... Giu? Ju? Pas... Giulietta Participazia, from Petrichor...

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: Err. This seems to be... a woman?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... Ah...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Um...

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: W—Wait! If you're not that woman, then why were you going on about some "flute" back there at Bayda Harbor?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: ...I was talking about... this flute?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: This is the flute my father gave me when I was about to leave home. He hoped that I would inherit the family business of instrument-making, but I...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: *sigh* Forget it.

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: Hold on. If this had nothing to do with you, then why did you run?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: "I'm sorry, but I really don't remember," I said that, didn't I? But you sounded so aggressive and looked so frightening. What was I going to do except run?

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: Well, this is my first job — one to remember! Of course I had to double my enthusiasm!

choices.text: To the point that you showed up three days in advance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You were way too anxious!

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: Ugh. Then where did that Giulietta Participazia go...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of that, the lady we ferried over first works in the instrument business... Y'know, the one who was going to be late for a business transaction? Didn't she call herself "Giulietta"?

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: What? So she's in Bayda Harbor now? I have to find her as soon as possible...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She seems to care a lot about credibility, so she probably wouldn't default...

response.speaker: Agent
response.text: You're going to get scammed if you hold onto such naive ideas. People lie — that's what the handbook says! Anyway, I've got to go find her, immediately!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The Agent departs...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously, where does he get the cheek to lecture Paimon based on that handbook of his!? He was the one who made a mistake...

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: What a farce... I see you're the same as ever, Big Brother. Always sucking people into whatever trouble you get into!

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: I don't know whether to laugh or be angry.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: I'm sorry, Giovanni.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: And sorry for the trouble, you two, but this is no place for a chat. Let's find a spot where I can treat you to some snacks, and we'll talk.

choices.text: Well, it looks like your career's in dire straits now...
Actually, I'm also here to collect a debt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! He hasn't paid us our triple boat fare either!

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Our town's a small place, and our desserts and tea are all quite ordinary, so they might not look like much to you who have traveled and seen much...

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: Giovanni, why do you have to talk like this? My heart is made of flesh and blood, just as yours is. It, too, can be hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Is that so? And here I thought that the heart of one who cares so little about their family would be made of immovable stone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Well... Paimon didn't think it'd turn out like this... This is so awkward!)

choices.text: Stop arguing, you're going to spoil the taste of the snacks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Anyway, you brothers have been reunited after many years, so shouldn't you be happier about that...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, c'mon! Help talk some sense into 'em, would you?

choices.text: I envy you. At least you've been reunited.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Actually, {NICKNAME}'s still searching for {M#his}{F#her} missing {M#sister}{F#brother}...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You briefly explain the reason for your journey to the two brothers...

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: I see... It must be hard, to have to scour the world for your family — and you're so young, too.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: #I'm sure your {M#sister}{F#brother} has {M#her}{F#his} reasons. I don't think {M#she's}{F#he's} forgotten you or has intentionally broken off contact. Please, don't hate {M#her}{F#him} for it.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: Ah. *sigh* To have been guided by a youth like you... We have truly shamed ourselves as elders.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: We may have had our disagreements, but we are still brothers...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Thank you... Giovanni.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: Ah, but don't be so quick to thank me. It was you who voluntarily gave up the family business. Now, I am the legal heir to the Pasquale name, no matter how you...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: It's alright, Giovanni, I know what you mean. But of all the things I've lost, I regained the most precious of them — as for the rest, I don't need them.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: Again, don't speak too soon. That novice debt collector wasn't talking out of his hat when he said that "people lie"!

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: In that case, let us sign a contract — write a statement in black and white! Or perhaps, if some other means suits you better...

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: We don't have to go that far...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Ah, it seems you're quite the same as you used to be. But I've changed. I'm not the man I was before. Let me work in your workshop.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: I shall be your assistant, just as you were mine when we were little.

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: Do your best, then. I'm not going easy on you just because you're my big brother.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Of course. No worries.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, so guess the two of you have made up now, eh?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Yes. Thank you so much for your help. Why, I somehow feel as if the triple-price fare was hardly enough! It's just a shame I only have this much on me...

response.speaker: Giovanni
response.text: If you can sit yourself down and work hard in the workshop, repaying their kindness would be a simple matter.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Hear that? Giovanni's going to take good care of me. If we should have the chance to meet again, I'll treat you two!

choices.text: Actually, never mind my problem. You two...
There's no point butting into someone else's family matters.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that's true, but...

choices.text: If I'd known, I'd have gone with that Agent...

dialogues.text: Do you two happen to be heading to sea as well? If so, please, could I trouble you to bring me along to Bayda Harbor?

response.text: Ah, I see... Oh dear, this is going to be a toughie...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if it's really urgent, we could still help...

response.speaker: Giulietta
response.text: Oh! What kind souls you are! In any case, my name's Giulietta, and I sell instruments.

response.speaker: Giulietta
response.text: Not long ago, I inked an order with some outlander gentlemen for a batch of materials from them. I mean, even the greatest artisan wouldn't be able to fashion an instrument from nothing!

response.speaker: Giulietta
response.text: According to the contract, the payment must be made within these two days at Bayda Harbor. But I overslept and missed the last boat...

response.speaker: Giulietta
response.text: *sigh* It might be the nightmares I've been having lately, but I couldn't sleep well... It is my fault, of course, but right now, I need to get to Bayda Harbor.

response.speaker: Giulietta
response.text: So if you'd be willing to help, I'd be immensely grateful. Three times the going rate — that's what I'll pay.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—Three times!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sure are generous, huh?

response.speaker: Giulietta
response.text: Well, it's a matter of trust and reputation. This is life and death for us businesspeople.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Well, sure seems that way...

choices.text: Sorry, but I don't intend to go out to sea right now.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You cross the sea and arrive in Bayda Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, I have some things to handle first...

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: Alright, but do hurry. Time waits for no one...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, get onboard.

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: In that case, let us not delay. To Bayda Harbor we go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll have to wait a while longer, I have something that needs doing.

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright. But do come back as soon as you can — we have an agreement, don't we?

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: Yes! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: Thank you both so much! Now I can deliver the payment as promised — we can't have our outlander friends viewing us Fontainians as fickle folk who flip on their agreements.

dialogues.speaker: Giulietta
dialogues.text: Well then, here's the payment, as promised!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, shiny, shiny Mora. As long as there's some to be had, we can do business!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That said, {NICKNAME}, since we're here already, why don't we have a look around? Even if we were to go back to Petrichor now...
Hmm? Did you two come from Petrichor by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't just talk to people from behind like that! You gave Paimon a fright!
Oh, did I startle you? My apologies, truly. I simply could not contain myself upon hearing my hometown's name...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you really have to get this excited, though?
Well... I left home when I was young, and I haven't been back since. Ten years flew by while I did business in Sumeru. Ten years without word from home...

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: Well, since you've come from there, could you tell me how things have been going? ... Right, I forgot to introduce myself. Just call me Giustino.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hello there, Giustino. Paimon's name's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}. And you've come to the right people — we have a "deep" understanding of Petrichor, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Hmm, wouldn't he think we're crazy if we told him that we followed a cat and wound up disrupting an ancient plot and resolving the crisis in his hometown, though?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Petrichor's doing great! How great, you ask? As great as before, that's how!

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Really? Just as before, then? That's good, that's good...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, wouldn't it be better for you to go, since you're a local, rather than rely on us outsiders?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: You speak reason! I should, yes. I did not bat an eyelid when I left it all behind back then, yet now I shrink back from my desire to return.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: How strange. My courage fails me as I grow older...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: If I hadn't found this flute in my baggage while packing...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: When I left home, I had nothing with me but this flute. In truth, my family disapproved of my departure, and my father snuck the instrument out to me at the last minute.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Haha, good times, though. Not a Mora to my name, but with the flute's melodic strains flowing free, a fire in my belly, and a dream, it was like the whole world was mine for the seizing.

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Later, I would make lots of friends in Sumeru, and my business would grow. *sigh* If only I could have written them a letter, but I had all but forgotten my family and home...

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Ahem... Anyway, if I may make such a request, would you be willing to take me with you when you return to Petrichor?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, you gonna pay us triple, too?

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Triple!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! The lady we just ferried over had urgent business to attend to, so she paid us triple for the ride!

response.speaker: Giustino
response.text: Well... I should have enough for that. Alright, I'll pay you triple too. "Strike while the iron is hot," as they say — since I've decided to return home, any delay will be detrimental.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we're not exactly professional boatmen or anything... But hehe, such premiums are tough to refuse!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: From Bayda Harbor, you then return to Petrichor...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you wait for a moment?

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: Of course. No worries.

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: Shall we head out now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a while more...

dialogues.speaker: Giustino
dialogues.text: Of course, no trouble at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there. Have you seen a merchant from Fontaine dressed in Sumeru garb?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Huh? A Fontainian wearing clothes from Sumeru? Sorry, I was a bit busy thinking about my composition, so I didn't notice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, alright then... Guess we should ask elsewhere, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there. Have you seen a merchant from Fontaine dressed in Sumeru garb?

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: I've not seen any such person. Has something happened? If there's an emergency case that requires the Special Patrol's services...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's not anything urgent, really... Anyway, we'll be looking elsewhere!
